name: doflab
description: DofLab：多板教學平台（Uno／ESP32／Raspberry Pi 4B）— 電路配置、行為積木、程式產生、模擬與數位孿生

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');for(const d of ['src/core','src/ui','src/drivers'])for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d))if(f.endsWith('.js'))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run bundle:e2e && python3 e2e/e2e.py
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:py
